description:
Prepare the purchase on this tab: record its terms, have Muse review it, and arrange payment when your assignment is to buy.

Supply the purchase as the page shows it. Group its amounts under `charges`, delivery and contact details under `fulfillment`, and the available payment route under `payment`. Use `status: draft` while gathering facts, leaving unknown values null and listing unresolved purchase requirements in `missing`. An empty card form does not belong there when preparation will supply the card. The result includes the available ways to pay.

Use `status: ready` to request Muse's cart review. A requested change comes back for you to make. For a purchase assignment, a confirmed cart proceeds to payment approval when needed, then returns the approved wallet card to enter or applies Shop Pay. For a preparation assignment, the call ends after cart review and arranges no payment. Set `record_only: true` to record either assessment without requesting review or payment. The call never presses the order control.

To record a merchant outcome and continue working, give `purchase_outcome` with the outcome, evidence and any merchant confirmation. Omit `purchase` when only recording an outcome; the recorded purchase terms remain available. Use `browser.report` when your assignment is finished.

Keep the purchase terms current as checkout progresses. Your checkout instructions say which changes need a fresh Muse review. Payment approval and funding are reused when they still cover the purchase. Enter any returned card with `browser.act`, and use `checkout.submit` at the final order step.

submit_ref.description: The reference of the control that places the order. Give this or submit_look.

submit_look.description: The order control in words, as it appears on screen, when it has no reference: what it is, its visible text and where it sits. Null otherwise.

submit_within.description: With submit_look, an element reference to search inside; null otherwise.
